name: Post Call Assistant
description: Turns a finished meeting into a list of your action items plus a follow-up message left in draft, deliberately stopping short of hitting send. Its first conversation establishes which notes, mailbox, calendar and reference links it should draw on, so expect a short setup before it earns its keep.

official.title: Post Call Assistant by Priya
official.description: Never miss a follow-up. After a meeting, drops your todos and a draft. Never sends. On first run it asks which notes, email, calendar, and links to use.
